title: Invariant checks on Today for Announcements and Deliveries
description:
Corrections are three ordered conditional writes that a retry finishes, because AppSync has no transaction across writes. Add checks, read by index for one Announcement at a time and run whenever the announce agent wakes for it: a successor Delivery whose predecessor is not marked superseded (finish it); a superseded Delivery still in the due index (clear it); two generations of one channel and account that are both not superseded (never open an attempt on the lower one); a Delivery row whose text file is missing or does not match its hash (do not send; flag); a missing `supersedes` relation (write it). Anything the wake cannot finish shows on Today as 'needs attention' with the two Delivery ids.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A half-finished correction is completed on the next wake without a second post.
- No attempt opens on a Delivery that is not the highest generation.
- An inconsistency a wake cannot fix is on Today.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- delivery-invariants.feature: a crash after the successor is created is finished on the next wake; the old Delivery leaves the due index; the lower generation is never sent; a row with no text file is not sent and is flagged.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Observability, safety and release readiness. Slice code J6 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
